materials.title: What we are made of
materials.parotaText: With deep grains and an untamed character. We select the finest Parota wood from Jalisco to create pieces that breathe the strength of our land.
materials.ironText: Where fire becomes art. Our cast iron handles are handcrafted by Mexican artisans, creating unique and unrepeatable pieces.
materials.clayText: Shaped by history. Each piece is born from Chiapas clay, transformed by the hands and brushes of indigenous women who express their worldview in every stroke.
materials.metalText: A flower that never fades. This emblematic design pays tribute to the City of Roses (Guadalajara), capturing the delicacy of its roses in locally forged metal.

about.olinalaText: The Panal Collection pays tribute to the legendary lacquer technique from Guerrero, Mexico. Each piece is a masterpiece of patience and detail, crafted from lináloe wood. A paste made from chia oil and mineral pigment called tecostle is applied to the surface. Using a huizache thorn or a feather, artisans carefully draw the intricate patterns that decorate our tortilla holders. Every design in this collection is unique and preserves centuries of Mexican history and culture.
about.martinaText: The Martina collection celebrates the union of wood and handcrafted metal. Each piece reflects the Mexican tradition of handmade work, where the strength of iron and the warmth of wood combine to create functional objects full of character.
about.jaguarText: Evoking the jungle and the culture of Chiapas, this collection represents the symbol of strength and spiritual connection: the Jaguar. In Amatenango del Valle, artisan Juana Gómez hand-molds each piece in white clay and then paints symmetrical patterns that connect tradition, culture, and nature.
about.panalText: Our Panal collection celebrates Mexican craftsmanship inspired by the shapes of nature. Each piece is designed to convey harmony, tradition, and beauty, blending artisanal techniques with contemporary design.
